public.instruction: Return original settings, merged settings and attribute lookup values. Merge defaults only for keys absent from existing; existing values including False, zero, empty strings and None win. Do not mutate existing settings. Unset attribute lookups return None. Inputs use ordinary string keys that do not shadow dict methods; nested JSON values are preserved as values, not recursively merged.
